languageEditions.newFinding_robotsMetaMismatch: robots.txt Disallow list omits cost-desk.html and executive.html, even though both carry <meta name=robots content=noindex> (grep-verified: cost-desk.html, executive.html, partner.html, team.html all have noindex meta; only partner/team additionally appear in robots.txt Disallow). This is actually backwards from the safer pattern: combining Disallow (in robots.txt) with a noindex meta tag on the SAME page is a known anti-pattern (crawlers blocked by Disallow never fetch the page, so they never see its noindex instruction, which can paradoxically leave a bare URL indexed with no snippet -- Google's own webmaster guidance flags this). cost-desk.html/executive.html (noindex-meta-only, no Disallow) are arguably the more correct pattern; partner.html/team.html (both Disallow AND noindex) are the ones worth reconsidering. Filed as a P2 SEO finding in AUDIT_REPORT.md, not urgent, needs no immediate action -- documented for STATE 3's SEO rollup so it isn't lost.
